A USB ID (2019:ab30) for a 881xAU '''Planex''' device (manuf. by '''AboCom''') is in '''Realtek''''s vendor driver set for the 881xAU series.. :The driver set for the [[ipTIME A2000UA]] indicates that it indeed used by the GW-900D (and the manuf. is noted as '''AboCom'''). It's probably an [http://www.abocom.com.tw/uploadfile/The%20brochure%20of%20AU7520_0329.pdf AU7520].
